summary: Selectis Health filed an 8-K disclosing completion of its take-private by Black Pearl Equities II, LLC via merger sub Tortuga Acquisition Sub on October 5, 2026, following a tender offer at $5.75 per share in cash that expired August 31, 2026. Approximately 90.93% of shares (2,789,027) were validly tendered, allowing a short-form merger under Utah law without a stockholder vote; Selectis survives as a wholly owned subsidiary. The 8-K also covers a change in control, officer/director departures and bylaw amendments. Watch for Rule 13e-3 dissenters' rights and any remaining-share squeeze-out mechanics.
